subject.title: Memory MVP: define SQLite schema and canonical record model

question: Should memory-core's durable memory source of truth move from Markdown files to a plugin-owned typed SQLite record model for the MVP, and what migration, review, and provenance contract must ship with it?
rationale: The request defines a stored data model and upgrade boundary that affects memory ownership, migrations, provenance, review/forget flows, and sibling Memory MVP issues; automation should not choose that product contract alone.

options.title: Approve plugin-owned SQLite MVP model
options.body: Define the v1 record, status, revision, provenance, and migration contract first, then implement the schema and tests in memory-core.

options.title: Keep Markdown canonical for now
options.body: Continue treating SQLite as retrieval/index infrastructure around Markdown durable memory and close or narrow this schema request later.

options.title: Defer until memory convergence
options.body: Keep this as design backlog until maintainers choose the recommended memory plugin path described in VISION.md.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-owned SQLite MVP model
recommendation.body: Define the v1 record, status, revision, provenance, and migration contract first, then implement the schema and tests in memory-core.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on the memory host, memory-core flush, and plugin-boundary surfaces that this schema would replace or migrate.
